claims: The 130th Boston Marathon takes place on Patriots' Day, Monday, April 20, 2026.
The 130th Boston Marathon features over 34,000 registered participants.
The Boston Marathon is the world's oldest annual marathon.
The Boston Marathon brings runners from over 130 countries.
The Boston Marathon follows the traditional Hopkinton-to-Boston route.
The Boston Marathon will be broadcast on ESPN2.
ESPN2 will broadcast the Boston Marathon from 9 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. ET.
Local coverage of the Boston Marathon in New England is available on WCVB Channel 5, WMUR News 9, WMTW Channel 8, and WPTZ NBC5.
The Boston Marathon can be streamed on Fubo TV.
The weather forecast for the 130th Boston Marathon expects cool and dry conditions.
The weather forecast for the 130th Boston Marathon expects high temperatures in the low 50s °F.
The weather forecast for the 130th Boston Marathon expects a cool breeze.
Professional wheelchair races for the 130th Boston Marathon start around 9:00 a.m. ET.
Professional wheelchair races are followed by professional runners and various waves throughout the morning.
24,362 qualifiers were accepted for the 130th Boston Marathon.
The 130th Boston Marathon has a record-fast cutoff time of 4:34.
The cutoff time of 4:34 is 4 minutes and 34 seconds faster than the qualifying standard.
The Boston Marathon course is 26.2 miles.
The Boston Marathon course passes through Hopkinton, Ashland, Framingham, Natick, Wellesley, Newton, Brookline.
The Boston Marathon course finishes on Boylston Street in Boston.
An estimated 500,000 spectators are expected to line the Boston Marathon route.
